dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: では初めさせて頂きますね
dialogue.English: Alright, shall we begin?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm a counselor.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.English: How can I help you today?

dialogue.content: もう疲れてしまいました
dialogue.English: I'm just so exhausted.

dialogue.content: それはしんどいですね
dialogue.English: That must be really tough.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学校から帰ると毎日家事をやらされて
dialogue.English: I'm forced to do chores every day when I get home from school.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 二学期中におわらせなければならかい課題も終わりそうにない
dialogue.English: And I don't think I can finish the assignments that are due by the end of the second semester.

dialogue.content: （お聞きしていますね）
dialogue.English: (I'm listening.)

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいのかわからない
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: とてもお辛い状況なんですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're in a very painful and difficult situation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみにあなたの年齢と性別を教えてもらえますか
dialogue.English: By the way, may I ask your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 17歳女子です
dialogue.English: I'm a 17-year-old girl.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 高校生でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you in high school?

dialogue.content: はい高校2年生です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm a second-year high school student.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学校の宿題もたくさんあって時間がいくらあっても足りない感じですよね
dialogue.English: You have lots of schoolwork too, and it feels like there’s never enough time, right?

dialogue.content: あなたが困ってしまっているのが目に浮かんできます
dialogue.English: I can picture how overwhelmed you are.

dialogue.content: ご家族はあなたのほかにどなたがいるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Who else is in your family besides you?

dialogue.content: 買物したり、食事を作ったり、洗濯したりで疲れてしまって
dialogue.English: I'm exhausted from doing the shopping, cooking meals, and doing the laundry.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 勉強が進みません
dialogue.English: I can't make any progress with my studies.

dialogue.content: そんなにもたくさんの家事を・・
dialogue.English: That's so much housework...

dialogue.content: 頭も悪いし
dialogue.English: And I'm not smart, either.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに感じてしまうのですね
dialogue.English: So that's how you've come to feel.

dialogue.content: だって成績1ばかりだもん
dialogue.English: Because all my grades are 1s.

dialogue.content: そっか・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 物理の試験でこんど赤点とったら単位落としちゃう
dialogue.English: If I get a failing grade on the next physics exam, I'll fail the class.

dialogue.content: 勉強する時間が全く取れないから・・心配ですね
dialogue.English: Not having any time to study... that must be worrying.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうすればいいんだろう
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: 学校は毎日行けてますか？
dialogue.English: Are you able to go to school every day?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 嫌だけど行ってます
dialogue.English: I don't like it, but I go.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみにあなたがどうしてそんなにひとりで家事をしないといけないのか教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, could you tell me why you have to do so much housework all by yourself?

dialogue.content: 中1のとき両親が離婚して、父と二人暮らしなんです
dialogue.English: My parents divorced when I was in the first year of junior high, and I've been living with just my father.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened.

dialogue.content: 父は仕事で忙しいからって、私に全部家事を押しつけてくる
dialogue.English: He says he's busy with work and dumps all the housework on me.

dialogue.content: うん、うん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, mm-hm.

dialogue.content: ちょんとやってないと怒鳴られるんです何やってるんだって
dialogue.English: If I don't do it properly, he yells at me, 'What are you doing?'

dialogue.content: そっか・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それではますます辛くなってしまいよね・・
dialogue.English: That must make it even harder for you...

dialogue.content: しまうよね・・
誰のお陰で飯食えると思ってんだとか
dialogue.English: He says things like, 'Who do you think is putting food on the table for you?'

dialogue.content: うん、うん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, mm-hm.

dialogue.content: そんなひどいことも言われて・・
dialogue.English: Being told such awful things...

dialogue.content: 悲しくなりますね
dialogue.English: That would make anyone feel sad.

dialogue.content: それに成績が悪いと、何でお前はそんなに馬鹿なんだって言われる
dialogue.English: And when my grades are bad, he says, 'Why are you so stupid?'

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それはあんまりですね
dialogue.English: That's just awful.

dialogue.content: だから頑張って勉強しようと思うけど上手くいかないし
dialogue.English: So I try to study hard, but it doesn't work out.

dialogue.content: 勉強する時間が全くないのに・・
dialogue.English: Even though you have no time to study at all...

dialogue.content: 悲しくなってしまう
dialogue.English: It just makes me sad.

dialogue.content: うん、うん泣きたい気持ちになりますね
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, mm-hm. It makes you want to cry, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: だからリスかしちゃうんです
dialogue.English: That's why I end up cutting myself.

dialogue.content: もう私なんて生きてない方がいいって思うと
dialogue.English: When I start thinking that I'd be better off dead,

dialogue.content: そっか・・そんなにも追い詰められてしまってるんですね
dialogue.English: I see... You're feeling so cornered.

dialogue.content: うん、うん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, mm-hm.

dialogue.content: なんとかいい方法かないか一緒に考えてみたいので、いくつか質問してもいいですか？
dialogue.English: I'd like us to think together about some possible ways forward. May I ask you a few questions?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 成績が良くないということなので、あなたの学校の先生にそのことを相談したことはありますか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned your grades aren't good; have you ever talked to a teacher at your school about that?

dialogue.content: 面談のときに成績のことを話したくらいです
dialogue.English: I've only talked about my grades during conferences.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: しっかりやれって言われてしまいました
dialogue.English: They just told me to get it together.

dialogue.content: 忙しいとか言い訳できなかった
dialogue.English: I couldn't make excuses about being busy.

dialogue.content: 勉強する時間がとれないとか、そういった今の現状は相談できてないのですね
dialogue.English: So you haven't been able to discuss your current situation, like not having time to study?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: あなたは忙しいお父さんに代わって家事すべてをしながら、学校は休まずに頑張って行っていてとても頑張り屋さんなのだとおまいます
dialogue.English: I think you're a very hard worker, handling all the housework for your busy father while still going to school without missing a day.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: でも、今のあなたには大人の支援がとても必要です
dialogue.English: But right now, you really need support from adults.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなた一人で頑張っても限界があるかと思います
dialogue.English: I think there's a limit to what you can handle all by yourself.

dialogue.content: あなたの学校にはスクールカウンセラーの先生とかはいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Does your school have a school counselor?

dialogue.content: います
dialogue.English: Yes, there is.

dialogue.content: できたら今の苦しい状況を相談することはできそうでしょうか
dialogue.English: Do you think you might be able to talk to them about your current painful situation?

dialogue.content: 知らない大人の人に話すのは怖いです
dialogue.English: I'm scared to talk to an adult I don't know.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・とまどってしまいますよねでもリスかしてしまうほどとても辛い状況をお話してみたら、力になってくれるかも・・
dialogue.English: I understand... it's daunting, isn't it? But if you could tell them about this situation that's so painful you're resorting to self-harm, they might be able to help...

dialogue.content: と思うのですが、勇気をだしてお話できたらいいなと
dialogue.English: That’s what I think; I hope you can find the courage to talk with them.

dialogue.content: 家のこと恥ずかしくて言いづらいです
dialogue.English: It's embarrassing and hard to talk about what's going on at home.

dialogue.content: そっか・・そう思うのは当然ですよねでも、ほかに学校の先生でお話しやすい先生とかはいますか？
dialogue.English: I see... it’s natural to feel that way. But is there any other teacher at school who you feel comfortable talking to?

dialogue.content: 保健室の先生かな
dialogue.English: Maybe the school nurse.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそしたら保険の先生にまず今の悩みを相談して先生から、あなたのお父さんに勉強する時間が全く取れずに単位まで落としそうだという状況をお手紙に書いてもらうとか、とにかくお父さんにわかってもらうことがとても大切かと思うのですが・・いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, how about you first talk to the school nurse about what you're going through, and maybe have her write a letter to your father explaining that you have no time to study and are at risk of failing your classes? I think it's very important to get your father to understand the situation... what do you think?

dialogue.content: 今行動に出なければ、ますますあなたが追い詰められてしまいそうで、とても心配です
dialogue.English: If you don't take action now, I'm very worried that you'll feel even more cornered.

dialogue.content: 私が相談したことが父に伝わったら何て言われるか恐ろしいです
dialogue.English: I'm terrified of what my father would say if he found out I talked to someone about this.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: お父さんのことがとても怖いのですね
dialogue.English: You're very scared of your father, aren't you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは、お父さんに口答えとかぜずにじっと耐えているのですね
dialogue.English: So you've been silently enduring it all without talking back to your father, haven't you?

dialogue.content: お父さんにもう限界にきているとか・・お話するのも怖くてできない感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: Are you too scared to tell your father that you've reached your limit?

dialogue.content: 言えません
dialogue.English: I can't tell him.

dialogue.content: そっか・・とても厳格な方なんですね
dialogue.English: I see... he must be a very strict person.

dialogue.content: 厳しいです
dialogue.English: He is strict.

dialogue.content: 叩かれたこともあります
dialogue.English: He has hit me before.

dialogue.content: 最近も
dialogue.English: Recently, too.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・怖かったですねでは、なおさらのこと代3者の大人の方に入ってもらい今の状況を変えていく必要があると思います
dialogue.English: I see... That must have been frightening. All the more reason, then, that I think we need a third-party adult to step in and help change the current situation.

dialogue.content: でもそれも怖いですどうなるかって思うと
dialogue.English: But that scares me too, when I think about what might happen.

dialogue.content: ほんとうに・・毎日怖い思いをしてよくがんばってこられましたね・・
dialogue.English: Truly... You’ve done so well to get through each day feeling so afraid.

dialogue.content: 誰にも相談できずに辛かったですね・・
dialogue.English: It must have been so hard, not being able to talk to anyone, hasn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お父さんの行為は虐待ともとれる行為なので、このままではとてもあなたのことが心配です
dialogue.English: Your father's actions could be considered abuse, so I'm very worried about you if things continue this way.

dialogue.content: お家のことを話すのは、とても勇気のいることですでも今日こうやってここに相談にきた頂いて、とても勇気をだしてくれたのですね
dialogue.English: It takes a lot of courage to talk about what's happening at home. But you showed great courage by coming here to talk today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: あなたは我慢強くて、勇気のある方なので保健室の先生にもきっとお話できると思います
dialogue.English: You are a patient and courageous person, so I'm sure you'll be able to talk to the school nurse.

dialogue.content: 保健室の先生には相談してみようと思います
dialogue.English: I think I'll try talking to the school nurse.

dialogue.content: はい、頑張って勇気をだしてまずは行動に移すことがとても大事です
dialogue.English: Yes, it's very important to gather your courage and take that first step.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: あなたのされていることは、身体的にも精神的のも虐待にあたることなので、きっと保健室の先生が力になって下さると思います
dialogue.English: What is happening to you constitutes both physical and emotional abuse, so I'm sure the school nurse will be able to help you.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: どんな理由があっても身体や精神的暴力はしてはいけないことなんです
dialogue.English: No matter the reason, physical and emotional violence is never okay.

dialogue.content: あなたは全く悪くないです
dialogue.English: You are not at fault at all.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: あなたは幸せになっていいんですいえ、なるべきです
dialogue.English: You deserve to be happy—in fact, you should be.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: あなたが、あなたらしく生活を送れるように祈っています
dialogue.English: I'm hoping you can live a life that feels true to you.

dialogue.content: 今日お話されたように保健室の先生にお話ししてみてくださいね
dialogue.English: Please try talking to the school nurse, as we discussed today.

dialogue.content: はいそうしてみます
dialogue.English: Okay, I will.

dialogue.content: 今日は勇気を出してこちらに相談にきていただいてありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for having the courage to come and talk with me today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ひとりで抱え込まずにまた辛くなったら、いつでもこちらにも相談にきてみてくださいね
dialogue.English: Don't try to carry it all by yourself. If things get tough again, please feel free to come back and talk to us anytime.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 今日の相談は大丈夫そうでしょうか
dialogue.English: Does everything about today’s session feel okay to you?

dialogue.content: お時間が過ぎてしまい申し訳ありません
dialogue.English: I'm sorry that we've gone over time.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です
dialogue.English: It's okay.

dialogue.content: では終了にさせていただきますね
dialogue.English: Alright, I'll end the session now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: （今日はお付き合いいただきありがとうございましたなかなか1時間以内にクロースできず時間が過ぎてしまいすみません）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the session today. I'm sorry I couldn't wrap it up within an hour and went over time.)

dialogue.content: （虐待が疑われるケースとても勉強になりました。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (This case involving suspected abuse was a great learning experience. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: （なかなか時間ぴったりは難しいですよ。こちらもとても勉強になりました。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (It's hard to finish exactly on time. This was a great learning experience for me as well. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: では終了ボタンを押させていただきますね
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll press the end button now.

dialogue.content: 了解しました。
dialogue.English: Understood.
